workflow_runs.display_title: Switch host: no redraw without a new vsync; [gs-host] shows upload an…

head_commit.message:
Switch host: no redraw without a new vsync; [gs-host] shows upload and draw+swap time under the driver lock

Passes without a new vsync redrew and swapped the same picture (~7 ms under the GL driver lock, ~45 times a second);
in gameplay the GS GL thread waited 1.8 s of every 5 s for that lock, now ~0.6 s.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
